description:
Born from the wind through advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) analysis, the TD01 Air slashes aerodynamic drag without weighing down your pedal stroke. Weighing just 980 grams (size M), the monocoque frame and fully integrated cable routing eliminate turbulence, ensuring a completely streamlined aesthetic. Engineered to deliver maximum stiffness during surges while maintaining genuine long-distance comfort, this aero race bike is built for riders who demand top-tier performance. Aggressive aerodynamics, lightweight performance, pure power transfer. Uncompromised.

Color isn’t just aesthetic; it’s identity. For the TD01 Air, high-gloss surfaces and reflective details accentuate the frame’s aerodynamic silhouette as you ride.

If our curated combinations aren’t enough, start with a blank canvas. From colour selection to finishes (matte, gloss or mixed), right down to the finest graphic details, we’ll create a Carrera that’s uniquely yours.

We employ a specialized blend of graphite fibers and high-performance epoxy resins—the exact structural standard utilized in aerospace and motorsport. By using Vacuum Bladder Moulding with internal EPS mandrels, we eliminate redundant carbon layup overlaps. The result is an exceptionally lightweight frame delivering a class-leading stiffness-to-weight ratio.

From XS to XL, the Erakle Pro monocoque frame is engineered to deliver the same balance of aerodynamics and power transfer for every rider. If you already know your bike fit measurements, use the Stack and Reach values to identify your ideal frame size.
